spec.description:
Thermotec E-Flex HT is a
high-performance, flexible closed-cell EPDM rubber foam pipe insulation
specifically engineered for solar hot water, HVAC, and high-temperature plumbing
systems. Designed with outstanding UV resistance, it withstands outdoor
weathering and sun exposure for many years without cracking, embrittlement, or
deterioration. It operates at continuous temperatures from -57°C up to +150°C
(with intermittent peak exposure up to 175°C - 180°C), preventing thermal energy
loss and solar line overheating.
features:
Manufactured from flexible
closed-cell EPDM rubber foam

Outstanding UV and weather resistance requiring
no additional protective painting or jacketing

Continuous operating
temperature from -57°C up to +150°C (intermittent to 180°C)

Engineered
specifically for solar hot water lines, HVAC, and refrigeration

Exceeds
BCA/NCC energy efficiency requirements for solar pipework (13mm wall achieves
R0.38 vs R0.30 mandate)

Low
flammability tested to AS/NZS 1530.3 with zero spread of flame
Self-extinguishing to ASTM D 635 and non-flammable to JIS K 6911

Green Star
and ODP-EMI4 compliant with zero ozone-depleting substances

Available in
standard 2m lengths, continuous coils, and multiple wall thicknesses

install:
Ensure copper or
stainless steel solar pipes are clean, dry, and leak-tested

For new pipework,
slide unslit E-Flex HT tubes directly over pipes prior to joint brazing or
connecting

For existing lines, slit E-Flex HT longitudinally using a sharp
insulation knife and snap over pipe

Apply Thermotec E-Flex Bond adhesive
evenly to both slit edges and allow to become touch-dry

Press slit edges
firmly together to create a continuous, permanent vapor seal

Butt
consecutive 2m lengths tightly and join with E-Flex Bond adhesive

Mitre cut
and glue sections around 90-degree elbows, tees, and solar collector
connections

Ensure complete coverage up to solar roof panel collectors
without leaving exposed copper
selection_checklist:
Confirm pipe is
solar hot water, heat pump, or high-temperature line exceeding 100°C

Measure
outside diameter of pipe to match internal diameter (ID) of E-Flex HT

Select
wall thickness (13mm WT standard to achieve compliant R0.38; 19mm or 25mm for
higher efficiency)

Order matching E-Flex Bond adhesive for joint and seam
sealing
Confirm external roof run requires UV-resistant EPDM material
accessories: Thermotec E-Flex Bond Adhesive (500ml tin with applicator)
Thermotec MaxTape FR / Insulating Foam Tape
limitations:
Not suitable for continuous operating temperatures exceeding 150°C (steam
lines over 150°C require Rockwool pipe insulation)

Slit seams must be sealed
with E-Flex Bond adhesive to maintain water tightness

Do not stretch
insulation lengthwise during installation as it will pull apart at butt joints
spec.warranty: Backed by Thermotec Australia product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Thermotec
E-Flex HT is an Australian-supplied, high-temperature EPDM closed-cell rubber
foam pipe insulation specifically engineered for solar hot water and HVAC
systems. Built with outstanding UV and weather resistance, it withstands outdoor
rooftop exposure without cracking or degrading, operating continuously from
-57°C to +150°C (with intermittent peaks to 180°C). Delivering an in-situ
R-value of R0.38 in 13mm wall thickness (exceeding NCC/AS 3500.4 mandates) and
fire-tested to AS 1530.3 (flame spread 0), it protects solar lines against
extreme thermal loss, freezing, and sun degradation.
